text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I wanted to become strong. There was 
someone I wanted to be.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
There were those who said I was just 
getting ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Don't push yourself." "Just accept it." 
"You might not understand yet, but..." 
"You don't have to act tough."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —It was annoying. I hated it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ……I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I knew it! I knew I was weak!! Even so—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I just couldn't give it up!!

"There is no way... you could ever be a 
weak Umamusume!!"

"‘There's no way you're a weak 
Umamusume!!’"

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I think so too, Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
(I'll keep being that! A super-strong 
Umamusume! The me who doesn't have a shred 
of weakness!)

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Guh... I won't lose...! Haaaaa............ 
AAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on, hit me with everything you've 
got! Your jealousy! Your respect! Your 
burning desire to win!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Standing right in front of you lot is an 
Umamusume stronger than anyone else!!"
(Wooooaaah!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Espoir City finishes in 1st place!! She 
has achieved consecutive victories in the 
Mile Championship Nambu Hai!

The moment Espoir City raises her fist, an 
earth-shaking cheer erupts from the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Is this... the "running born from 
rethinking a hundred times"...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No one else could ever run like this... 
Even if it's not in a straight line—it's 
so beautiful.

As the strongest Umamusume, Espoir City 
was showered with both praise and rivalry.
choice_data_list: (That was a perfect run)

text_block_list.text:
That run was packed with everything taught 
to her so far. She had understood all we 
had to offer, and completely made it her 
own.

...I believe I was able to provide the 
ideal education.

Rather than a one-size-fits-all approach, 
develop the skills and abilities each 
Umamusume needs using your own unique 
methods.

"And above all, she's learned how to make 
the most of her own strengths."

If that's the case... what is the final 
thing she needs to learn?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, what kind of education do you 
think Espoir needs?

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"For an Umamusume... for that girl. What 
do you think the role of an educator is?"

...The world blurs. The lights are 
blinding.

My hands tremble slightly as I clap. But 
surely, the last thing I can do is—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...! Hey, Trainer! Get your ass over here 
too!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Because you're MY Trainer!!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —I get to choose the next race?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's the issue.
Yeah, that's the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Assignment"...? Man, you sound just like 
a teacher, oi.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
You decide that shit yourself. I'll just 
put in my requests...
choice_data_list: No good, you have to decide for yourself.
No, you have to decide.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
choice_data_list: Because it's very important.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: I'll settle this. Flawlessly.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'll raid 'em using the strongest route 
you could never even dream of!
choice_data_list: ...Yeah! I'm looking forward to it!
...Yeah! I'm looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ...Go ahead and get excited!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Races I wanna run, huh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, that ain't it. Probably. ...She said 
it was an 'assignment,' after all."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: The race I'll run, huh...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: (—I wonder what she'd think.)

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...In almost every race, he'd usually give 
me the order to run as a "Leader".

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Running as a pacesetter didn't just hone 
my speed. ...I think my sharpness got 
better than before, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ……I've gotten crazy fast, haven't I?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
In fact, before the Kashiwa Kinen, I even 
broke my personal best across all 
distances.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Hahaha.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
That guy is insane. Nothing about their 
training was normal.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
“Thanks to that training, though, my 
acceleration went up, and my late-race 
kick got much sharper.”

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...So now, we can have a real interesting 
match."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume who's strong across three 
categories... well, of course she'd be 
formidable.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind, Trainer. I'm 
entering the JBC Sprint.

"The JBC Sprint is a dirt sprint GⅠ. It 
will be a lightning-fast clash where dirt 
speedsters gather to show off their pace."
choice_data_list: Will you tell me why you chose that?
Could you tell me why you chose that?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Since you ordered me to run as a Pace 
Chaser, I learned how to run with 
versatility, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides... there's no issue with my 
sharpness, right? My speed is top-notch!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Then let's invade the sprint division too 
and blow the whole country away."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If you're strong at the mile, medium 
distance, AND sprint... that makes you the 
absolute strongest Umamusume, doesn't it?
choice_data_list:
I see, it's a choice that takes your 
strengths and goals into account, huh

I see, it's a choice that takes your 
strengths and goals into account, isn't it

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I'm the horse girl who's gonna be number 
one in Japan, ya know.

I have no objection to the answer she 
gave. ...I write the name of the race onto 
the race registration form.
choice_data_list:
Become the strongest dirt Umamusume for 
me, Espo.
Become the strongest dirt Umamusume, Espo.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. In the race I choose, I'm gonna 
be the one who wins.
Target race changed to the JBC Sprint.

And so, she made her choice. Her next 
target was—the JBC Sprint.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Every time we raced, all he ever told 
me was to run from the back.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
With that run, speed wasn't the only thing 
that got sharpened. ...I think my turn of 
foot got sharper than before, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Well... I've learned to run more 
dexterously now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Besides... there's no issue with my 
sharpness, right? My speed is top-notch!

I'm the horse girl who's gonna be number

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...He'd often tell me to run as a "Front 
Runner," wouldn't he?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, the battle for the lead 
was brutal, man. Not that I was about to 
lose that fight at the front, though.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Though I guess to make up for it, they 
respected my sheer guts, at least."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Though they put me through a crazy amount 
of training for it, too."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Whenever something happens, it's always 
'pace this, pace that'.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Even when we went to Kokura for my debut 
race, you told me to run at a 12-second 
pace—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...It's already been two whole years since 
then, huh.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
We did all kinds of training, didn't we? 
Trained our stamina like crazy, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"We really honed your internal clock, 
didn't we? Playing all those games with 
Falco on the bus and everything."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
......I've really become an amazing 
Umamusume, haven't I? Seriously...—I'm so 
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Though there's still a title I'm 
missing, huh. I haven't taken "that one" 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If we're wrapping up this year anyway... 
I'm gonna do it with a smile."

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind, Trainer. I'm 
entering the Champions Cup.

"The Champions Cup, the race that decides 
the king of the autumn dirt division, 
which she ran in last year as well."
choice_data_list: Will you tell me why you chose that?
Could you tell me why you chose that?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: My weapon is this pure grit.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And with this front-running speed you 
helped me forge, I'll leave those dirt 
beasts eating my dust.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
And then grab it— the glory of "Best Dirt 
Horse Girl", too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
—Ain't no Umamusume out there who rocks 
the title of champion better than me, 
right?
